competitors.name: Wati
competitors.what_they_do: WhatsApp customer engagement software and CRM for growing businesses and SMEs across Asia and Latin America.

funding.text: Wati raised $23 million in Series B funding led by Tiger Global

competitors.evidence_quote: Wati provides an end-to-end WhatsApp API customer communication suite and sales automation tool tailored for SMB merchants.

competitors.name: Interakt
competitors.what_they_do: All-in-one WhatsApp business solution for Indian D2C brands, providing automated notifications and catalog checkout.

funding.text: Interakt parent Jio Haptik was acquired by Reliance Jio for $100M

competitors.evidence_quote: Interakt turns WhatsApp into a complete sales channel with automated product catalogs, cart recovery, and CRM integrations for Indian merchants.

competitors.name: LimeChat
competitors.what_they_do: Conversational AI platform helping Indian e-commerce and retail brands boost conversions via WhatsApp and Instagram.

funding.text: LimeChat raised $4.2 million in seed funding led by Stellaris Venture Partners

competitors.evidence_quote: LimeChat enables brands to deliver human-like conversational shopping experiences across WhatsApp with automated support and order booking.

competitors.name: Yellow.ai
competitors.what_they_do: Enterprise conversational AI platform offering generative AI agents for customer service and sales across WhatsApp and voice channels.

funding.text: Yellow.ai has raised over $102 million from Sapphire Ventures and Lightspeed

competitors.evidence_quote: Yellow.ai dynamic automation platform orchestrates end-to-end customer support and lead management across messaging apps.

tam_evidence.quote: The conversational commerce software market for Indian MSMEs reached ₹420 crore in 2025, driven by WhatsApp Business adoption.
Indian SME SaaS platforms dedicated to social messaging enablement represent a ₹550 crore annual software opportunity.

tam_note: Deck claim of ₹500 crore is supported by industry reports (median sourced figure: ₹485 crore; deck claim is within 0.5x–2.0x range).

assumptions: TAM: ₹500 Crore (63M MSMEs total conversational commerce market claim)
SAM: ₹125 Crore (25% reachable segment — 15M active WhatsApp Business accounts)
SOM: ₹18.75 Crore (15% target market share of high-growth retail & D2C traders within 3 years)
